info.name: FakeRESTApi Test Collection
info.description: API test collection for https://fakerestapi.azurewebsites.net. Request names follow the TC numbers in the Test Plan (section 7). Expected results follow the Test Plan; a failing test may indicate an actual API finding.

item.name: TC-03 GET Activities by ID (not found, 99999)

exec: pm.test("Status code is one of [404, 400]", function () { pm.expect([404, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: TC-04 GET Activities by ID (invalid format, abc)

exec: pm.test("Status code is one of [400, 404]", function () { pm.expect([400, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("Status code is one of [404, 400]", function () { pm.expect([404, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("Status code is one of [200, 404]", function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: TC-25 POST Users (empty userName and password)
TC-26 GET Users (password must not be exposed)

exec: pm.test("Password is not exposed in response", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().every(function (u) { return !u.password; })).to.be.true; });

item.name: TC-17 Access via HTTP (no redirect followed)

exec: pm.test("Status code is one of [301, 302, 307, 308, 400, 403, 404]", function () { pm.expect([301, 302, 307, 308, 400, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
